name: Microservices Architecture and Development
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) as a companion certification

beginner.summary: For developers moving from single applications to services. Covers what microservices are, monoliths and modular monoliths, finding service boundaries, REST service APIs, a first service with its own database, synchronous calls, messaging with RabbitMQ, containers, Docker Compose, discovery and configuration, API gateways, database per service, timeouts and retries, correlation IDs, health checks, service-to-service security, testing, CI/CD per service and a first Kubernetes deployment. Labs use Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET or Python, whichever the group knows.
prerequisites: Builds REST APIs in one back-end language such as Java, C#, Node.js or Python
outcomes: Explain when microservices help and when they hurt
Build services with their own data, APIs and messaging
Run several services with containers, a gateway and monitoring
Test, deliver and deploy services independently

subtopics: Costs and risks of distributed systems
Common building blocks: gateway, discovery, messaging and observability
Choosing a language for the course labs
Installing Docker, Docker Compose and a local Kubernetes
An HTTP client and a message broker console
The course case study: an online food ordering system
How the labs build on each other
days.lab_task: Set up the lab toolchain, run a prebuilt two-service system with Docker Compose, trace a request across both services and write down the parts of the food ordering case study.
days.deliverable: Working lab environment and case study notes
checks: Both services start and answer requests
Request path across both services described
Gateway, discovery, messaging and monitoring roles explained

days.topic: Monoliths, Modular Monoliths and Microservices Compared
subtopics: Signals that a split is worth it
Case studies of success and failure
days.lab_task: Analyse a sample monolith, propose a modular monolith and a microservices design for it, compare cost, risk and delivery speed and recommend one for the case study company.
checks: Cost, risk and speed compared for both designs
Signals for and against splitting listed
Recommendation fits the company's team size and goals

days.topic: Finding Service Boundaries with Business Capabilities
subtopics: Data ownership as a boundary test
days.lab_task: Run a short event storming session for the food ordering system, group events into capabilities, propose service boundaries with data ownership and review them for coupling.
days.deliverable: Event storm and service boundary map
checks: Domain events and commands captured on the board
Each service owns its data and capability
Chatty or circular dependencies found and fixed

days.lab_task: Write OpenAPI contracts for the restaurant, menu and order services with errors, idempotent order creation, pagination and a versioning plan, and lint them with Spectral.
checks: Spectral rules pass for all three services
Repeated order requests create one order
Backward-compatible change added without a new version

days.topic: Building a First Service with Its Own Database
subtopics: Running the service in a container
tools: Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, Node.js or FastAPI
days.lab_task: Build the menu service in your chosen language with its own PostgreSQL database, migrations, configuration, a health endpoint, structured logs and a container image.
checks: Service creates its own schema on start

subtopics: When synchronous calls are a problem
days.lab_task: Make the order service call the menu service to validate items, add timeouts and error handling, measure fan-out latency and try the same call over gRPC.
checks: Order service rejects items missing from the menu
Latency for HTTP and gRPC compared

days.lab_task: Publish an OrderPlaced event to RabbitMQ, consume it in kitchen and notification services, acknowledge correctly, send failures to a dead letter queue and handle a duplicate message.
checks: Kitchen and notification services both receive the event
Message lands in the dead letter queue after retries

days.topic: Packaging Each Service in a Container
days.lab_task: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles for every service, tag images by version, push them to a registry, run them as non-root and scan them for vulnerabilities.
days.deliverable: Images for all services in a registry
checks: Every service has a versioned image

days.topic: Running Several Services with Docker Compose
days.lab_task: Run the whole food ordering system with Docker Compose, including databases, RabbitMQ and all services, with health-based start-up order and a profile for optional tools.
checks: All services healthy with one command
Optional monitoring tools start only when asked

subtopics: Registries such as Consul or Eureka
days.lab_task: Register services in a discovery registry, call them by name instead of address, move settings to a configuration server and change a setting without rebuilding images.
checks: Services find each other through the registry

days.topic: API Gateway Concepts and a First Gateway
subtopics: Gateway as a single point of failure
tools: Kong, Spring Cloud Gateway, YARP or NGINX
days.lab_task: Put a gateway in front of the services with routes, token checks, rate limits and one aggregated endpoint for the order screen, and test what happens when the gateway restarts.
checks: Clients reach every service through one address
Order screen gets data from three services in one call
objectives: Secure and limit traffic at the edge

subtopics: Why services should not share databases
days.lab_task: Give the order, menu and payment services separate stores, keep a copy of menu data in the order service updated by events and build a simple cross-service report.
checks: No service reads another service's database
Menu changes reach the order service copy
Report combines data from three services

days.topic: Timeouts, Retries and Fallbacks Between Services
days.lab_task: Inject latency and errors between the order and payment services, add timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotency and a fallback, and show the order flow survives.
checks: Order screen loads when recommendations fail

days.topic: Logging Across Services with Correlation IDs
subtopics: Why logs are hard in distributed systems
Correlation IDs across HTTP and messages
days.lab_task: Add structured logs with a correlation ID passed through HTTP calls and messages, collect logs centrally and follow one order across all services.
checks: One correlation ID finds logs from every service
Consumers log the same correlation ID
No addresses or card data in logs

subtopics: Metrics for services: rate, errors and duration
days.lab_task: Add liveness and readiness checks and request metrics to every service, scrape them with Prometheus, build a dashboard per service and alert on error rate.
days.deliverable: Monitoring setup with dashboards and alerts
checks: Readiness fails for the affected service
Rate, errors and duration shown per service
Alert triggers on a raised error rate

days.lab_task: Protect the gateway with user tokens, pass identity to downstream services, give each service its own client credentials and scopes and store secrets in a vault.
checks: Direct call without a valid token rejected
Downstream service sees the user ID
Kitchen service cannot call payment endpoints

days.topic: Testing Microservices: Unit, Component and Contract Tests
subtopics: Component tests with real dependencies in containers
Running tests per service in CI
days.lab_task: Write unit and component tests for the order service with Testcontainers, a Pact contract between order and menu services, and a test for the kitchen message consumer.
checks: Order service tests pass against real PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ
Pact verification fails when the menu API changes
Consumer test processes a sample message
objectives: Test services at the right level

subtopics: Deploying one service without the others
days.lab_task: Create a pipeline per service that tests, builds, scans and pushes images, deploys only the changed service to staging and rolls it back without touching others.
checks: Changed service deployed while others keep running

days.topic: First Deployment of Services to Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Deploy the food ordering system to a local Kubernetes cluster with Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets and probes, expose the gateway through Ingress and do a rolling update.
checks: Update completes with no failed requests

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Online Food Ordering Microservices
days.lab_task: Complete the food ordering system with bounded services, own databases, REST and messaging, a gateway, resilience, central logs, monitoring, tests, pipelines and a Kubernetes deployment, then present it.
checks: Order flows from placement to delivery notification
System keeps taking orders when the notification service is down
Service boundaries justified by capability and data
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one system

intermediate.summary: For developers and leads already running a few services. Covers domain-driven design and context maps, event-driven architecture with Kafka, sagas, the outbox and inbox patterns, CQRS, event sourcing, gateway and BFF patterns, service mesh, resilience patterns, distributed tracing, consumer-driven contracts, versioning APIs and events, OAuth2 and mTLS, consistency and idempotency, Kubernetes deployment patterns, progressive delivery, configuration at scale, workflow engines and strangler migrations.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed several services that talk over HTTP and messaging
Comfortable with Docker and basic Kubernetes
outcomes: Design services and events with domain-driven design
Keep data consistent with sagas, outbox and CQRS
Secure, observe and test service estates

days.topic: Domain-Driven Design for Microservices: Bounded Contexts and Context Maps
subtopics: Mapping contexts to services and teams
days.lab_task: Build a context map for a marketplace with six bounded contexts, choose relationship patterns, design two aggregates with invariants and add an anti-corruption layer to a legacy system.
checks: Relationships between contexts named with patterns
Legacy model translated at the boundary

subtopics: Kafka topics, partitions and consumer groups
Event design: notifications and state transfer
days.lab_task: Publish order and payment events to Kafka with keys that preserve ordering, consume them in three services, monitor lag and document the events in a catalogue.
checks: Events for one order processed in order
Lag visible and recovers after a slow consumer catches up
Every event has an owner, schema and example

subtopics: Why distributed transactions do not fit
tools: Saga library or workflow engine for your language
days.lab_task: Implement checkout as a choreographed saga and as an orchestrated saga, add compensation and timeouts, and compare how easy each is to follow and change.
days.deliverable: Two saga implementations and a comparison

days.topic: The Transactional Outbox and Inbox Patterns
subtopics: Relaying the outbox by polling or change data capture
Cleaning up outbox and inbox tables
days.lab_task: Replace a dual write with an outbox relayed by Debezium, add an inbox to the consumer, crash the service mid-flow and prove no events are lost or duplicated.
days.deliverable: Outbox and inbox implementation with crash tests
checks: No lost events after the crash

days.lab_task: Build an order history read model from events for the customer screen, show eventual consistency in the UI, rebuild the model from scratch and test the projection.
checks: Customer screen served by one query
UI handles the short delay after a write

days.lab_task: Event-source the wallet service with streams per wallet, snapshots, an upcaster for a changed event and projections for balances and statements.
checks: State rebuilt from events matches the balance
Old events read correctly after a schema change

days.topic: API Gateway Patterns and Backends for Frontends
tools: Kong, Spring Cloud Gateway, YARP or Envoy
days.lab_task: Split the gateway into an edge gateway and two BFFs for web and mobile, translate tokens at the edge, cache public data and manage configuration as code.
checks: Web and mobile BFFs return client-shaped data
Gateway changes applied from a repository

days.topic: Service Mesh with Istio or Linkerd
subtopics: Traffic policies: retries and timeouts in the mesh
days.lab_task: Install a service mesh, enable mTLS between services, move retries and timeouts into mesh policy, split traffic for a canary and compare the operating cost.
checks: Benefits and costs recorded for the team
objectives: Decide when a mesh is worth it

days.topic: Resilience Patterns: Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads and Rate Limits
days.lab_task: Add circuit breakers, bulkheads and load shedding to the order flow, run chaos experiments that kill and slow services and show the system degrades gracefully.
checks: Calls fail fast while a dependency is down
Slow dependency does not exhaust other calls
Key flows keep working during experiments

subtopics: Linking logs and metrics to traces
days.lab_task: Instrument every service with OpenTelemetry, propagate context through HTTP and Kafka, sample traces, find the slowest step in checkout and link logs to traces.
checks: One trace spans all services and the broker

subtopics: Why end-to-end tests do not scale
days.lab_task: Add consumer contracts for three consumers, verify providers in CI, use can-i-deploy to gate releases and add a message contract for OrderPlaced.
Evolve an event schema under backward compatibility, run two API versions side by side, publish a deprecation timeline and remove the old version when traffic reaches zero.
checks: Old version removed after zero traffic

days.topic: Security: OAuth2, JWT Propagation and mTLS
subtopics: OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for service estates
days.lab_task: Threat model the system, validate tokens in every service, exchange tokens for downstream calls, use workload identities with mTLS and rotate secrets without downtime.
checks: Threats mapped to every service and channel

days.lab_task: Make payment and stock flows idempotent, handle out-of-order events with versions, write a reconciliation job that finds mismatches and test with duplicated and reordered messages.
checks: Late events ignored by version checks
Reconciliation job reports and fixes mismatches

days.lab_task: Package services as Helm charts from a shared library, set resources, autoscaling and disruption budgets, restrict traffic with network policies and deploy with Argo CD.
checks: Argo CD syncs every service from Git
Network policy blocks an unexpected call

days.topic: Progressive Delivery: Canary and Blue-Green Releases
days.lab_task: Release a service with an automated canary that checks error rate and latency, roll back a bad version automatically and switch a second service with blue-green.
checks: Bad canary rolled back by analysis
Traffic switched with no failed requests

tools: Vault or a cloud secrets manager
days.lab_task: Move all service secrets to a secrets manager synced by External Secrets, manage configuration per environment in Git, change a dynamic setting safely and audit the change.
checks: Services read secrets synced from the manager
Change recorded with author and time

subtopics: When to use a workflow engine
Workflow engines compared with sagas in code
days.lab_task: Rebuild the refund process as a durable workflow with retries, a human approval step and a timeout, version the workflow and compare it with the saga version.
checks: Running instances finish on the old version

days.topic: Migrating a Monolith with the Strangler Fig Pattern
subtopics: Choosing the first service to extract
Running old and new in parallel
days.lab_task: Extract the notifications capability from a monolith behind a proxy, sync data with change data capture, run both in parallel and switch traffic with a flag.
checks: Traffic moves to the new service without client changes
New service data matches the monolith
Next extractions ranked by value and risk

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Event-Driven Order Management Platform
days.lab_task: Build an event-driven order platform with bounded contexts, sagas, outbox, CQRS read models, a BFF, mesh mTLS, tracing, contract tests and progressive delivery, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, running platform, reports and presentation
checks: Order flows across services with compensation on failure
Contracts, chaos and tracing evidence meet targets
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For architects, staff engineers and platform leads. Covers architecture trade-offs and when not to use microservices, team topologies and Conway's law, platform engineering, large-scale event streaming, multi-region services and data, reliability engineering, capacity planning, zero trust, change data capture and data mesh integration, observability at scale, cost engineering, governance and paved roads, cell-based architecture, multi-tenancy, serverless services, testing in production, merging over-split services, AI services and distributed incident troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building and running microservices in production
Strong knowledge of messaging, Kubernetes and observability
Has led design decisions for a team
outcomes: Make and defend architecture decisions for service estates
Design multi-region, reliable and secure platforms
Run platforms, governance and cost programmes

days.topic: Microservices Architecture Trade-offs and When Not to Use Them
subtopics: Case studies of moving back to monoliths
days.lab_task: Analyse three real case studies, score service granularity with drivers and disintegrators for a sample estate and write decision records for merging and splitting.
checks: Warning signs identified in the sample estate

subtopics: Stream-aligned, platform, enabling and complicated-subsystem teams
days.lab_task: Map the services of a sample organisation to teams, find cognitive overload and ownership gaps, propose a new team topology and plan the change.
days.deliverable: Team and service map with proposal
checks: Every service has one owning team
Teams with too many services or domains identified

days.lab_task: Build a golden path that creates a new service with repository, pipeline, observability and deployment from a Backstage template, and measure time to first deploy.
checks: New service deployed from the template in under an hour
Service appears in the catalogue with its owner

days.lab_task: Design the topic and partition strategy for 200 services, replicate between two clusters, build a stream processor for fraud signals and estimate platform cost.
checks: Partition counts justified by throughput and ordering
Monthly cost modelled for the design

days.lab_task: Design an active-active order platform across two regions, handle write conflicts, route users by region, run a regional failover and record the impact.
checks: Users served from their nearest region
Conflicting writes resolved by the agreed rule
Traffic moves to the other region within the target time

days.topic: Reliability Engineering: SLOs, Error Budgets and Chaos
subtopics: SLIs and SLOs for user journeys
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for three journeys, set an error budget policy, run a game day with chaos experiments across services and update the reliability roadmap from the results.
days.deliverable: SLOs, game day report and roadmap
checks: Release frozen when the budget is spent

days.topic: Performance and Capacity Planning Across Services
days.lab_task: Split a latency budget across the checkout call chain, load test the estate, build capacity models per service and forecast hardware for twice the traffic.
days.deliverable: Capacity plan with load test results
checks: Each service has a latency budget that adds up
Capacity for twice the traffic estimated

days.topic: Zero Trust Security Architecture for Microservices
days.lab_task: Issue workload identities with SPIRE, enforce service policies with OPA, sign and verify images, detect suspicious runtime behaviour with Falco and review the result.
checks: Disallowed service call blocked by OPA
Falco alerts on a shell in a container
objectives: Use workload identity and policy engines

days.topic: Advanced Data Patterns: Change Data Capture and Data Mesh Integration
days.lab_task: Publish domain data products from two services through change data capture with contracts, quality checks and lineage, and serve an analytics use case without touching service databases.
days.deliverable: Data products with contracts and lineage
checks: Consumers read the product without service database access
Bad records caught by quality checks
Lineage traced from service to report
objectives: Use change data capture at scale

tools: Grafana stack or a commercial platform
days.lab_task: Design telemetry standards for 100 services, set up tail sampling in the collector, cut telemetry cost by half while keeping error traces and build service dependency maps.
checks: Telemetry volume halved with error traces kept
Service map shows real call paths

subtopics: Cost allocation per service and team
days.lab_task: Allocate a month of platform cost to services and teams, find the biggest waste, right-size workloads and calculate cost per order.
checks: Every service has a monthly cost
Savings achieved with no SLO breach

days.topic: Governance: Standards, Paved Roads and Architecture Reviews
subtopics: What to standardise and what to leave free
days.lab_task: Write service standards, encode three as automated fitness functions, build scorecards in the developer portal and run an architecture review for a new service.
Partition customers into cells with a cell router, deploy changes cell by cell, fail one cell and show other customers are unaffected.
checks: Each customer always reaches its cell
Release rolls out one cell at a time
Only customers in that cell affected

subtopics: Isolation at data, compute and network levels
days.lab_task: Propagate tenant context through HTTP and messages, isolate data per tenant in three services, protect against noisy neighbours and automate onboarding across services.
checks: Tenant ID present in every service and message
No cross-tenant data in any service
Other tenants unaffected during a flood

subtopics: State with durable functions or step functions
tools: AWS Lambda and Step Functions or Azure Functions and Durable Functions
days.lab_task: Rebuild the notification and refund flows as serverless functions with an orchestrated state machine, trace them end to end and compare cost with containers.
checks: Cost compared at three traffic levels

days.topic: Testing in Production and Synthetic Monitoring
subtopics: Feature flags for testing in production
days.lab_task: Run synthetic checks for key journeys, mirror production traffic to a new service version, dark-launch a feature behind a flag and compare results safely.
checks: Synthetic check alerts on a broken journey
New version handles mirrored traffic without user impact
Feature runs hidden with metrics collected

days.lab_task: Find two over-split services from tracing and change data, merge them into one service with one store, migrate clients and measure the improvement.
checks: Coupling shown with tracing and change frequency data

days.topic: AI Services in a Microservices Estate
subtopics: Retrieval services and shared vector stores
days.lab_task: Add a shared AI gateway with quotas per service, a retrieval service used by two product services and tracing for AI calls, and report cost per team.
days.deliverable: AI platform services and cost report
checks: Two services use the retrieval service
objectives: Add AI services to an estate

subtopics: Finding the failing service from symptoms
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a retry storm, a poison message backlog, a cascading timeout and an ordering bug, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Each cause backed by traces, logs or broker data
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-region, cell-based service platform with a golden path, zero trust, event streaming, SLOs, cost allocation and governance, then defend it to an architecture review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, architecture pack and defence
checks: Platform keeps serving users within its SLOs
New service deployed through the golden path in a day
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
